scenes.heading: Messy notes?
scenes.label: START WITH A SAFE COPY
scenes.narration: Meeting notes are only useful when they lead to action. Start with a copy that removes private names, customer details, and confidential information.

scenes.heading: Give AI a clear job
scenes.label: ONE SIMPLE PROMPT
scenes.narration: Ask your AI tool to extract each action, its owner, and its deadline. Tell it to write not specified whenever the notes do not contain an answer.

scenes.heading: Check the result
scenes.label: AI CAN MAKE MISTAKES
scenes.narration: Compare the result with your original notes. Reject invented names or dates. Ask the team to confirm anything that is missing.

scenes.heading: Make it actionable
scenes.label: A TASK NEEDS THREE THINGS
scenes.narration: Now place the confirmed actions in your task list. Each task needs a clear outcome, one owner, and an agreed deadline.

scenes.heading: Try it today
scenes.label: START WITH ONE MEETING
scenes.narration: Try this with one short meeting. Review the result before sharing it, and save the prompt for next time.
